messages:
Priya: Quick sync — we need to finalize the product-facing approach for model catalog lifecycle around onboarding and migrations. Proposal: introduce a customer opt-in 'soft-pin' mode that lets customers lock a specific model version while we run a staged migration. Launch gates: bench variance, perf delta, and rollback criteria. Need feedback on metrics and who owns canary ops.

Mike: +1. Important we define concrete bench thresholds and a minimum canary cohort size. Also how long is the grace window for pins?

Jun: Suggested thresholds (rough sketch):
```json
{
  "p95_latency_change": "<= +15ms relative",
  "regression_alert_threshold": ">= 1% user-visible error increase",
  "quality_delta": "BERT/ROUGE drop <= 0.015 (depending on task)",
  "cohort_size": ">= 2000 requests or 24h of traffic (whichever comes first)"
}
```
Those are workload-sensitive, but gives a starting point.

Sam: From sales/context: customers will ask for explicit SLAs during the pin period and likely ask for credits if migration causes regressions. Can we draft an opt-in contract clause? Also need a simple comms blurb for AEs.

Tess: Operational notes: canary rollout plan should include automatic fallback routing + a fast kill. Ops checklist:
- route 1% -> new model -> monitor telemetry (latency/errors/quality)
- 1h -> 5% -> 12h -> 25% -> 100% (only if gates pass)
- automatic fallback to pinned model on any critical alarm
We should codify these as a rollout policy so Dedicated/Private customers can opt-in too.

CanaryBot: deploy-event: canary job queued by @Jun for us-west1 (test namespace) — no traffic yet.

Priya: Good notes. Action items I hear:
1) Jun to draft bench spec (include workload slices + test prompts) by EOD Thu.
2) Tess to author rollout policy snippet and failure-mode playbook by Mon.
3) Mike to define grace-window options (30/60/90 days) and economic triggers for auto-renew.
4) Sam to draft customer opt-in clause + AE one-pager.

Can we keep this lightweight — aim for an internal RFC next Tue and a decision by end of week. If you agree, drop a :thumbsup: and I will calendar.

Mike: :thumbsup: I can take the ownership for grace-window modeling.

Jun: Will add example benchmark slices (search-heavy, chat, embeddings) and include automated eval harnesses.

Tess: I'll put the rollback runbook into the ops repo and link it in the RFC.

Sam: I'll sketch the comms + contract language and share a draft.

Priya: Thanks team — will create RFC + calendar invite. If anyone wants to add edge cases (multi-region pin, quantized-only pin) drop them in this thread before EOD.
